yang2024_figS7A.source: Yang HH, et al., Wilson RI (2024) Cell. Europe PMC PMC12778575, supplementary file NIHMS2118063-supplement-Supplementary_Figure_7.pdf, panel A (DNa02, n = 4 cells in 4 flies)
yang2024_figS7A.legend: Mean DNa02/DNg13 spike rate when the fly was walking (and not making ipsiversive turns, i.e. any turning was in the contraversive direction) compared to epochs the fly was not walking. Dots are individual flies, and horizontal lines are the means across flies.
yang2024_figS7A.method: dot coordinates read from the vector PDF, y axis calibrated on its 10/40/70 Hz ticks (dna02_yang2024_figS7A.py); the recovered group means match the drawn mean lines

yang2024_text: Although this stride-locked firing rate modulation was only about 15 spikes/sec (approximately 10% of the cell's dynamic range), it was highly consistent across DNa02 recordings.
rayshubskiy2025_text: DNa02 has a relatively high basal firing rate (Fig. 1D) (author response, eLife API articles/102230)
the entire dynamic range of neural activity is shifted downward during immobility, so that the peak firing rate (and peak depolarization) is reduced. (Fig. 6D legend)
